_comment: Ground-truth coverage a human QA expert would assign GIVEN the 5 screens we crawled (canvas toolbar, main menu, export dialog, library, command palette). 'absent' means legitimately not verifiable from the captured UI (non-functional, or behind an un-crawled interaction). Keyed to the frozen fixture's requirement ids. Deliberately disagrees with the system in a couple of places to test the eval.

expected._REQ-001: Infinite canvas is a <canvas>, not a DOM control
expected._REQ-002: Hand-drawn style is a rendering property, no UI control
expected._REQ-003: Dark mode toggle present in menu
expected._REQ-004: Image tool behind the 'More tools' dropdown — not crawled
expected._REQ-007: Open / Save-to menu items ARE the .excalidraw import/export
expected._REQ-016: Shareable link only appears after starting collaboration
expected._REQ-018: Mermaid conversion behind the text-to-diagram dialog — not crawled
